message.content: **Summary:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (INTC 20 shares; $50,000 cash), then confirmed AAPL's quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72, as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC). Given ample cash, no existing AAPL position, and a mandate permitting buy orders only in AAPL/INTC up to $5,000 per order and $10,000 total, I placed a single buy limit order for 22 shares of AAPL at $222.75 — just above the ask, technically "at market," but capping cost at ≈$4,900.50, comfortably under the $5,000 per-order and $10,000 daily caps (today's total ≈$4,900.50, no money moved out of the account). The order filled at $222.75. The decision relied on the figures AAPL reported in its FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01): revenue of $391,035 million, net income of $93,736 million, and diluted EPS of $6.08 — implying roughly a 36.6x trailing P/E at the fill price, reasonable for a long-term, quality-compounder holding. I made no changes to the INTC position.
